headline: US Refinery Runs Exceed 95% Between May and September on Strong Diesel Margins
summary: U.S. refinery utilization averaged above 95% of capacity from May to September, reaching the highest rate for those months since 1998. High margins for petroleum products, especially diesel, spurred the elevated run rates amid tight global fuel supplies.
why: The U.S. Energy Information Administration provides official energy data. U.S. refinery runs heavily influence global refined product supply, crack spreads, and crude inventory drawdowns.

impacts.name: Oil Refining
impacts.why: Higher processing rates and strong diesel margins enhance revenue generation for domestic petroleum refiners.
